task: T5: document the channel in docs/. Explain the two environment variables and state plainly that with no URL configured the loop posts nothing, polls nothing and behaves exactly as before — that is the portability guarantee and a reader needs to know it is guaranteed rather than incidental. Document the three endpoints, the run key that identifies a run, and the JSON each direction carries. Record WHY the channel is outbound in both directions: nothing can connect into a worker, because a container has no published port and a k8s Job has an ephemeral name and then ceases to exist, so a control cannot be sent to a worker and must instead be noticed by it while polling — exactly how a GitHub Actions or GitLab runner discovers that its job was cancelled. Say that this is what makes the worker portable rather than what limits it. Document the failure discipline: fail open on the channel and closed on the intent, so a coordinator that is down never stops a build and an unreadable answer is never treated as a cancel. Note what deliberately is not here — the coordinator itself, transcript streaming, and any inbound endpoint — and where each belongs. Change nothing under `scripts/`.
